title: Move to the published quest/lore 0.14.1 pair
description: Version drift found by the Sunday estate audit (opum-doc approved owner tasks; orchestrator record OPAG-1521, relayed by team-lead 2026-10-25). Measured on origin/dev 5384e8e, 2026-10-25: CLAUDE.md:4 declares Quest CLI 0.13.0 in the managed block; .github/workflows/ci.yml:51 pins LORE_VERSION: 0.13.0; npm publishes 0.14.1 for both @opum-ai/quest and @opum-ai/lore (npm view). quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude reports version-only drift, exit 0. Same shape as GCLI-8 (the 0.12.0 -> 0.13.0 move): regenerate the managed Quest block with quest agents --update-instructions --target claude (routine managed-block carve-out), bump LORE_VERSION to 0.14.1, regenerate .lore/schemas/ with lore schema export under 0.14.1 in the same change as the pin (schemas and pin land together, LCLI-690), and refresh the lore agent bridge where it applies. Routed by the orchestrator to this repository; do not start until the day's plan schedules it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The managed Quest block in CLAUDE.md declares Quest CLI 0.14.1, and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude reports current rather than version-only drift on the PR head SHA in the Tracker integrity job.
The .github/workflows/ci.yml LORE_VERSION is 0.14.1, and the Docs job on the PR head SHA logs Resolved lore version: 0.14.1.
The .lore/schemas/ JSON Schemas are regenerated by lore schema export under lore 0.14.1 and are committed in the same change as the CI pin bump (schemas and pin land together, LCLI-690).
The required contexts (Docs, Tracker integrity, Check) are all green on the PR head SHA.

plan: 1. Branch chore/GCLI-22-quest-lore-0-14-1 off origin/dev; claim GCLI-22.
2. Regenerate the managed Quest block at 0.14.1 (quest agents --update-instructions --target claude) and bump ci.yml LORE_VERSION to 0.14.1.

3. Regenerate .lore/schemas/ with lore schema export at 0.14.1 in the same change as the pin (LCLI-690); refresh the lore agent bridge with lore agents; inspect docs/log.md and keep its diff only if the dated entry set is unchanged.
4. Run bun run check plus the pinned-version quest and lore checks; record versions and exit codes.
5. Open a PR into dev, land on green, record the evidence on GCLI-22, delete the local branch. No promotion to main.
implementationNotes:
LANDED GCLI-22: PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#50, squash 48a50af07448109c9c95bfad5736167166eab787, head SHA f34118479ba0e5ca9dd3bf6395ca8e6ac3550958. CI run 40195877910 on that head: Docs pass (20s), Tracker integrity pass (21s), Check pass (27s).

EVIDENCE PER CRITERION, read from the run log rather than the conclusion alone:
1. Managed block and quest check: Tracker integrity logged "Declared Quest version: 0.14.1", "Resolved quest version: 0.14.1", and the Managed-instructions step printed "state: current" on the PR head. The block was regenerated with quest agents --update-instructions --target claude under installed 0.14.1; only the version line moved. Locally quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 0 with state: current.
2. Pin and resolved lore: Docs logged "Resolved lore version: 0.14.1" (its install step checks the installed binary against LORE_VERSION and fails on a mismatch, so the pin and the resolved binary are the same string). ci.yml LORE_VERSION is 0.14.1.
3. Schemas with the pin: lore schema export under lore 0.14.1 wrote 11 schemas in the same commit as the pin bump. All eleven profileDigest values move; adr.schema.json additionally gains its decisions property. Committed together per LCLI-690.
4. Required contexts: Docs, Tracker integrity and Check all green on f341184 in run 40195877910.

LOCAL VERIFICATION (host bun 1.3.14, lore 0.14.1, quest 0.14.1): bun run check exit 0 (typecheck, biome lint, biome format:check, 74 tests, 420 expect calls); lore check exit 0 (6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings); lore check --strict exit 0; lore validate --strict exit 0 (6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 2 non-concept files skipped); lore agents --check exit 0, still reporting absent-plugin-sourced, which is expected here because skill_source = "plugin" and GCLI-23 is the task that drops it; docs/log.md untouched, so there was no sync diff to review against the entry-set rule.

NOTHING PROMOTED TO MAIN, as instructed.

DEC-182 (1) CLASSIFICATION, added 2026-10-25 after team-lead's promotion question, read from opum-doc's planning record (DEC-182, status accepted).

This delivery changed .github/workflows/ci.yml (LORE_VERSION 0.13.0 -> 0.14.1). DEC-182 (1)'s path floor names "CI workflows or rulesets" and "pins" among the sensitive paths, and it states the floor is one the leader's judgment cannot lower; nothing in this repository's profile narrows it. So this task was sensitive work: under (2) it should have been authored at Sonnet or above and gated by an Opus security review. It was authored by a session running deepseek-flash[1m] (per that session's own runtime context; DEC-182 (10) says to verify the authoring model from the transcript, not a route field) and was reviewed by nothing beyond the required checks going green. That is the (1)/(2) breach shape.

REMEDY: per DEC-182 (9) and (10), a breach is remedied by an Opus security review BY REF of the sensitive diff — here the ci.yml hunk plus the pin and schema delta carried by PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#50 — not by re-implementation, since identical code re-typed on a stronger model adds no security and the diff has already been read. That review is not run here and is not this repository's to self-serve: the reviewer must be an Opus session, and this writer is not one. glyph-cli is private until first release, so no release or install gate is pending today; the review should still be dispatched before one exists.

GCLI-23 is ORDINARY under (10) and needs no such review: .lore/config.toml and the generated .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md are not permissions, hooks, routing or model selection; the CLAUDE.md change regenerated a managed block rather than hand-editing it; and nothing was loosened. The sensitive-path floor in (1) does bind in glyph-cli, as it binds fleet-wide.
finalSummary: Move glyph-cli from the quest/lore 0.13.0 pair to 0.14.1. Changed: CLAUDE.md's managed Quest block regenerated at 0.14.1 (only the declared version line moved); .github/workflows/ci.yml LORE_VERSION 0.13.0 -> 0.14.1 (the only CI pin either tool carries; the Tracker integrity job derives Quest's version from the managed block); .lore/schemas/ regenerated by lore schema export under 0.14.1 in the same change as the pin (LCLI-690) -- all eleven profileDigest values move and the ADR schema gains its decisions property. Verified on PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#50, squash 48a50af, head f341184, CI run 40195877910: Docs resolved lore 0.14.1 with validate --strict and check --strict green, Tracker integrity declared and resolved quest 0.14.1 with instructions state: current, Check green. Locally under bun 1.3.14 with lore and quest 0.14.1: bun run check green (74 tests), lore check and lore check --strict exit 0, lore validate --strict exit 0, quest agents --check exit 0. lore agents --check still reports absent-plugin-sourced by design here; GCLI-23 drops skill_source = plugin next. docs/log.md untouched. No promotion to main.
